cues: In electronics labs, a springy shrouded plug connects test leads securely to binding posts on meters and power supplies.
Researchers have tested discarded peel as a biosorbent, using its porous plant matter to remove textile dyes from wastewater.
Green-stage flour can supply structure in gluten-free baking, helping dough hold together without wheat proteins.
A freshly cut flower stalk may ooze sticky sap that darkens on skin, making prompt cleanup useful for harvesters.
A curling free kick bends around a defensive wall, letting a striker target the far side of goal.
A mature leafy canopy can shelter young cacao seedlings from harsh sun when both crops share an agroforestry plot.
